headlines.description: — Kevin Durant made two free throws with 3.2 seconds left for the last of his 35 points, and the Houston Rockets held on to beat the Charlotte Hornets 105-101 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Durant scores 35 points as Rockets hold on to beat Hornets 105-101

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell scored 17 points, James Harden added 16 and the Cleveland Cavaliers routed the Brooklyn Nets 112-84 on Thursday night to extend their winning streak to a season-high six games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cavaliers extend win streak to 6 with 112-84 rout of Nets

headlines.description: — Jalen Johnson had 32 points and 10 rebounds and CJ McCollum added 23 points as the Atlanta Hawks beat the Philadelphia 76ers 117-107 on Thursday night in the teams' first game after the All-Star break.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johnson and McCollum power Hawks past the 76ers 117-107 as Atlanta snaps 3-game skid

headlines.description: — Bub Carrington and Anthony Gill each scored 13 points and helped spark a decisive fourth-quarter run as the Washington Wizards outlasted the Indiana Pacers 112-105 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wizards beat the Pacers 112-105, snapping a 3-game slide

events.name: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Cade Cunningham had 42 points and 13 assists to lead the Detroit Pistons to a 126-111 win over the New York Knicks on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cunningham's 42 points, 13 assists lead Pistons to a 126-111 win over the Knicks

headlines.description: — Brandon Ingram scored 31 points and the Toronto Raptors returned from the All-Star break to beat the Chicago Bulls 110-101 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raptors return from the All-Star break to beat the Bulls 110-101

events.name: Phoenix Suns at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Stephon Castle scored 20 points, Victor Wembanyama added 17 and the San Antonio Spurs beat the short-handed Phoenix Suns 121-94 on Thursday night for their seventh straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spurs beat the Suns 121-94 in Austin for their 7th straight win

events.name: Boston Celtics at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — Jaylen Brown had 23 points, 15 rebounds and 13 assists for his third triple-double of the season, and the Boston Celtics rolled over a Golden State Warriors team playing without Stephen Curry, 121-110 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brown helps Celtics thump Curry-less Warriors 121-110

headlines.description: — Paolo Banchero scored 30 points and the Orlando Magic beat Sacramento 131-94 on Thursday night for the Kings’ franchise-record 15th straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Magic use 3-point flurry to hand the Kings their franchise-record 15th straight loss

headlines.description: — Bennedict Mathurin scored 38 points in his home debut for Los Angeles and the Clippers held off the Denver Nuggets 115-114 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mathurin scores 38 points in his Clippers home debut in 115-114 win over the Nuggets
